detail.longDescription: This is my first time participating in Hacktoberfest , and I'm excited to dive deeper into open source. I’m looking forward to: 🔹 Contributing to real-world projects 🔹 Exploring new repositories and technologies 🔹 Learning from other contributors 🔹 Making meaningful PRs and improving my development skills I’m especially interested in AI/ML, web development, and developer tools, so I’ll be looking for projects where I can learn while contributing. Let’s see how many meaningful contributions I can make this Hacktoberfest! 🌱💻 Hacktoberfest # OpenSource # GitHub # OpenSourceContribution # DeveloperCommunity # beginners # learning # opensource # software # coding # development # engineering # inclusive # community 🚀 Starting my Hacktoberfest journey!
